create.name: Amy Secada
create.bio:
Amy Secada is a dancer and movement teacher who created the Dance of the Chakras Method, a seven-stage practice that pairs each chakra with movement, breath, mudra and mantra. Trained at the School of American Ballet in New York, she spent years as a professional dancer and choreographer before turning to ancestral dance, studying in Senegal, Congo, Angola and India and settling in Brazil in 2011. She has trained in Capoeira for more than two decades, is a certified Ashtanga Vinyasa yoga teacher who has studied in Mysore, and is a daughter of the Monacan Indian Nation.

Her classes blend African and Afro-Brazilian dance, martial arts, yoga philosophy and the chakra system, so that dance is treated as prayer and as a way back into the body. She teaches the method through a recorded online course, a monthly online dance ceremony and a two-level certification for teachers who want to lead it themselves, with an in-person intensive in Bahia. She has taught at festivals and retreat centres in many countries, including a week-long Dance of the Chakras course at Esalen.

courses.title: Dance of the Chakras Method (online course)
courses.description: A recorded course of more than 22 hours that moves through the seven chakras in turn with dance, breathwork, mudras and mantras drawn from yoga, martial arts and African dance. A shorter two-hour foundations module is also sold on its own.

courses.title: Dance of the Chakras Teacher Training, Level 1: Somatic Dance Practitioner
courses.description: A nine-week online training of 45 hours with weekly live sessions, self-paced modules and personal practice, introducing the method and how to guide others through it. It leads on to a 100-hour Level 2 facilitator certification with an in-person intensive in Bahia, Brazil.
courses.price: $555 USD early bird; $777 USD after 30 November
